seo.description: Charrana Beach: a scenic Mediterranean cove near Nador for swimming and a quieter beach day.

name: Charrana Beach
hero_subtitle: Cliff-backed clear water about an hour from Nador — a quieter swim than the lagoon strip.

overview.title: Clear water away from the lagoon
overview.p1: Charrana is a cove of golden sand and clearer Mediterranean water set under cliffs, roughly an hour from central Nador.
overview.p2: It is popular with people who want a proper swim day rather than only lagoon walks. Services are lighter than a big resort beach — pack accordingly.
overview.p3: Combine with a late return to the corniche if you still want city energy in the evening.

food.title: Food near Charrana Beach
food.p1: Beach services are seasonal and light — bring water and snacks for the sand, then plan a fuller meal in Nador on the way back.
food.li1: Pack water and fruit for the beach.
food.li2: Seasonal beach snacks may appear in summer.
food.li3: Seafood on the corniche is a solid end to the day.
food.li4: Do not rely on a full restaurant menu at the cove.
food.li5: Buy supplies in town before the drive.
food.p2: Charrana is about swimming and scenery more than dining.
